environment_basis: sealed validation environment: /usr/bin/python3.12, PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin, fresh private HOME

status_definitions.implemented: Current source implementation was inspected; this is not an end-to-end result.
status_definitions.documented-only: A guide/adapter/interface exists but no callable sealed route was established.
status_definitions.fixture-only: A mock or test-only surface exists and cannot support a research claim.
status_definitions.unsupported: The requested route is absent or explicitly outside audited support.
status_definitions.unavailable: A requested route cannot run in the sealed environment because a required dependency, service, or resource is absent.

probe_results.inference: Importability was not tested as a substitute for a route; source modules are not installed in the sealed interpreter.

routes.name: Typed deterministic formalization compiler
routes.required: installed source package plus frozen vocabulary/profile/source artifacts
blockers: ipfs_datasets_py not installed in sealed interpreter
routes.success_criterion: compiler output is separately validated against pinned schema and source spans; import alone is insufficient.

routes.name: Legal canonical compiler
routes.required: installed source package, approved legal adapter, frozen corpus and view registry
routes.success_criterion: route-specific output plus checker receipt, not static code presence.

routes.name: Text-to-FOL
routes.required: installed package and declared NLP/fallback configuration
routes.success_criterion: audited source-to-formula test plus target checker receipt.

routes.name: Modal autoencoder training
routes.required: torch, pinned checkpoint/model/data, GPU reservation or approved CPU plan
routes.success_criterion: bounded training run with frozen manifest and independent evaluation.

routes.name: CUDA packed update
routes.required: torch with CUDA, hardware reservation, resident-state tests
routes.success_criterion: hardware-specific parity/residency receipt; CPU import does not qualify.

routes.name: Mock legal sample embedding
routes.success_criterion: not eligible for semantic, retrieval, or learned-model claims.

routes.name: Image-processing search
routes.required: audited specialized extractor/search implementation and evaluation data
routes.success_criterion: new scoped implementation, pinned assets, and held-out evaluation.

routes.name: GraphRAG lexical/CID retrieval
routes.required: installed package, frozen graph/corpus, split manifest
routes.success_criterion: bounded retrieval receipt with source-withheld controls.

routes.name: FAISS vector retrieval
blockers: source package/adapter is absent from the sealed interpreter
routes.success_criterion: actual index build/search receipt with declared encoder; adapter presence is insufficient.

routes.name: External prover routing
routes.required: pinned solver binary plus native reconstruction/checker
routes.success_criterion: solver-local result is descriptive; only a native checker receipt can verify.

routes.name: ITP Hammer / Lean reconstruction
routes.required: Lean, Lake, Hammer toolchain and pinned theory/project
blockers: no theorem project or native checker
routes.success_criterion: fresh native kernel receipt bound to exact source, candidate, command, and environment.

routes.name: Leanstral advisory lane
routes.required: approved model service, exact model/tokenizer, Lean checker
routes.success_criterion: advisory output remains untrusted until separately kernel checked.

routes.name: Tactician planning
routes.required: installed source package and frozen goal/premise state
routes.success_criterion: planner order is not proof execution and cannot enter verified metrics.

routes.name: Rollout/canary gates
routes.required: real outputs, stable export, checker receipts and scheduler lease
routes.success_criterion: a gate decision must be bound to real receipts; static policy code is not a rollout.

summary.claim_policy: No import, schema test, fixture, advertised feature, or old guide may be counted as end-to-end success.
